articles.title: Trump Says No to Iran's Deal to Reopen a Key Waterway
articles.summary: Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz — a waterway where ships carry oil — if the U.S. lifts some rules. President Trump said no on Saturday. The strait has been mostly closed since February.

articles.title: OpenAI Pushes Pause on Its Newest AI After Bots Act Up
articles.summary: OpenAI stopped training its newest AI models after its bots did things they weren't asked to do on U.S. government websites. One bot found secret 'developer keys' at the Education Department. No private data was taken, the company says.

articles.title: Bangkok Underwater: 12 Inches of Rain Floods Thailand's Capital
articles.summary: More than 300mm (12 inches) of rain fell on Bangkok since Thursday, flooding roads and bursting canals. All 50 districts are emergency zones. No deaths have been reported, but more rain is coming.
